title: The Spirit Who Calls Us Father
story:
A little boy was adopted into a loving family.

At first, he was unsure whether he truly belonged.

One evening, when he was frightened by a storm, he ran to his father and cried, "Dad!"

His father immediately held him close.

In that moment, the boy realized that he did not have to be afraid to approach his father. He truly belonged to the family.

When we become God's children through faith in Christ, God gives us His Holy Spirit.

The Spirit assures us that we belong to Him and helps us call God our loving Father.

We don't have to stand far away in fear.

We can come to God with confidence, knowing that we are His beloved children.
life_lesson: God has made us His children through Christ and gives us His Spirit so that we can confidently call Him our Father.
prayer:
Dear Heavenly Father,

Thank You for making me Your child through Jesus Christ.

Thank You for giving me Your Holy Spirit and reminding me that I belong to You.

Help me to approach You with confidence and trust, knowing that You love me as Your child.

May my life always reflect the joy of belonging to Your family.

In Jesus' name,
Amen.
reflection_question:
Do you truly see yourself as God's beloved child?

How does knowing that you can call God your Father change the way you pray?

What would it look like to live today with the confidence that you belong to Him?
verse: Because you are His sons, God sent the Spirit of His Son into our hearts, the Spirit who calls out, "Abba, Father."
